content: Vercel Cron Jobs on Hobby (free) plan: max 2 cron jobs per project, minimum frequency is once per day (any cron expression more frequent than daily fails at deploy time with 'Hobby accounts are limited to daily cron jobs'). Timing isn't guaranteed to the minute. A true 15-minute pre-warm cron is not achievable on free tier; only Pro plan supports sub-daily cron.
